references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.97(4) (Official Gazette 993+994, 26-12-2019, p.43): a wage paid 15 days or more late earns at least the interest on the late sum at the 1-month term-deposit rate (lãi suất huy động tiền gửi có kỳ hạn 01 tháng) that the bank holding the employer's payroll account publishes on the payment day; a force-majeure delay may not exceed 30 days. HR raises one request per late payment: the amount is the sum paid late, and `late_wage` records the due day, the paid day and the bank's published rate with its notice. The days late are the paid day less the due day (the first day out, the last day in: State Bank Circular 14/2017/TT-NHNN art.4(2)(a)). Owner rule 2026-09-28: art.97(4) states no day count; default actual days over a 365-day year, the State Bank's rule for deposit interest (Circular 14/2017/TT-NHNN art.4(1): a rate is a % a year, a year is 365 days); rounded up to the whole đồng so the payment is never below the interest the law sets as its minimum. Owner rule 2026-09-28: art.97(4) places the compensation in its force-majeure sentence and is silent on a delay without force majeure; default the same compensation for any delay of 15 days or more, lawful because art.97(4) is a minimum (“ít nhất”) and nothing forbids paying it; a delay without force majeure is also an offence remedied by a sanction decision (Decree 12/2022 art.17, Decree 283/2026 art.23), which this class does not replace. Owner rule 2026-09-28: the law does not say whether the compensation is salary income; default taxable (counts toward PIT), not insured (not a regular wage item under Decree 158/2025 art.7(1)).

Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.104 (Official Gazette 993+994; unchanged in consolidation 18/VBHN-VPQH of 12 Feb 2026): a bonus (thưởng) is money, property or another form the employer awards on the results of production and business and the worker's degree of work completion; the bonus regulation (quy chế thưởng) is the employer's, decided and published at the workplace after consulting the grassroots worker representative where one exists. The law sets no amount, no minimum and no 13th-month or Tết bonus: HR raises one request per bonus paid, the amount is the sum the regulation awards. The published regulation and the consultation are the employer's conduct, not a payroll input (evidence NONE). Salary income taxed in the month paid: Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC art.2(2)(e) (“Các khoản thưởng bằng tiền hoặc không bằng tiền dưới mọi hình thức”, except the state-honour and award bonuses of e.1–e.4: state titles and commendations, national and international awards, technical innovations, reporting violations) and, for tax period 2026, Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(2)(i) (the state-honour and award bonuses excluded by art.8(4)(a)). Outside the insurance salary: Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(c) excludes the supplements that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance, and Circular 10/2020/TT-BLĐTBXH art.3(5)(c) sets art.104 bonuses apart from the contract's wage supplements; HI, UI, the union fee and union dues read the same insured salary, so none of them reads it.

MINIMUM_WAGE_FLOOR.description: Checks that a monthly contract wage is at least the regional minimum wage for the employer's region on the contract start date.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 arts.90(2), 91; Decree 74/2024/NĐ-CP art.3 (the version’s rules.minimum_wage.by_region). An entity without a recorded region is checked against Region IV, the lowest floor; part-time, probation (at least 85% of the job wage, art.26) and intern terms are outside the monthly check.

OVERTIME_MONTHLY_CAP.description: Checks that the month's planned overtime, including the entry being saved, does not exceed 40 hours.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): overtime may not exceed 40 hours a month. Counted from the roster entries' planned overtime intervals in the month, each interval once; the engine recognises no other overtime.

OVERTIME_DAILY_CAP.description: Checks that actual overtime on a roster day does not exceed 50% of the day's normal hours, or the 12-hour daily ceiling under a weekly-hours arrangement.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(a): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly regime normal plus overtime hours at most 12 a day.

DAMAGE_DEDUCTION_CEILING.description: Checks that a property-damage deduction does not exceed 30% of the latest payslip's net wage.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.102(3): the monthly deduction may not exceed 30% of the monthly wage actually paid after compulsory social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance and personal income tax.

OVERTIME_ANNUAL_CAP.description: Checks that the year's planned overtime does not exceed 200 hours, or 300 hours where the employer is approved for the extended cap.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 hours a year; art.107(3): 300 hours in the sectors and cases listed, after notifying the provincial labour authority (art.107(4); Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP arts.61–62). Counted from the roster entries' planned overtime intervals in the calendar year, each interval once. Work on a public holiday or rest day counts only where it is entered as planned overtime; the engine recognises no other overtime.

REGION_REQUIRED.description: Requires the sealed employer profile covering the contract start date to record a minimum-wage region.

references.title: Decree 74/2024/NĐ-CP arts.3–4: the minimum wage is the region of the employer’s place of operation.

HOURLY_MINIMUM_WAGE.description: Checks an hourly or daily contract rate against the regional hourly minimum, converting a daily rate over the normal hours and days.
HOURLY_MINIMUM_WAGE.condition:
const rate = get(ctx.entry, 'terms.rate', null);
return rate !== null && ['HOURLY', 'DAILY'].includes(rate.unit);

references.title: Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP art.3, art.4(2)–(3): an hourly wage is at least the regional hourly minimum. A daily wage converted to an hour (over the normal hours of the day) or to a month (over the normal working days of the month) may not fall below the hourly or monthly minimum.

PROBATION_WAGE.description: Checks that a probation wage is at least 85% of the wage the job pays at the end of probation.
PROBATION_WAGE.validate:
const job = get(ctx.entry, 'employee_extension_data.probation_job_wage_vnd', null);
return ctx.entry.terms.rate.amount >= ctx.lookup.share * job;

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14

PROBATION_PERIOD.description: Checks the probation length against the statutory maximum for the job class.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: at most 180 days for an enterprise manager, 60 for a college-level job, 30 for an intermediate or technical job, 6 working days for any other.

PREGNANT_OR_INFANT_NIGHT_OVERTIME.description: Checks a roster day with actual work: a pregnant employee has no night work or overtime (no consent exception); one raising a child under 12 months needs the day’s consent for each.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.137(1)(a): no night work, overtime or long business trips from the seventh month of pregnancy (sixth in remote areas), with no consent exception; art.137(1)(b): while raising a child under 12 months, night work and overtime need the employee's day-specific consent. Read on employee_contract.children (expected_on three months ahead, born_on) and the roster day's consent object.

MINOR_WORKING_TIME.description: Checks the daily and weekly hours, overtime and night work of an employee under 18 against the limits for their age and job.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.146(1)(b): a worker from 15 to under 18 works at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job).

WEEKLY_REST.description: Checks the weekly rest or, where the employer averages rest monthly, the minimum rest days in the roster month.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; where the cycle does not allow it, at least four days a month on average (entity fact rest_averaged_monthly).

ROSTER_NORMAL_HOURS_DAY.description: Checks that normal hours actually worked on a roster day stay within the contract day or the 10-hour weekly-arrangement ceiling.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.105(1)–(2): normal working hours at most 8 a day and 48 a week; under a weekly arrangement at most 10 a day (term fact normal_hours_arrangement).

ROSTER_NORMAL_HOURS_WEEK.description: Checks that normal hours actually worked across the seven-day window stay within 48 hours.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.105(1)–(2): at most 48 normal hours a week.

ROSTER_OVERTIME_DAY.description: Checks that planned overtime on a roster day is at most 50% of the contract's normal day and that normal plus overtime stays within 12 hours.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): overtime at most 50% of the normal hours of a day; under a weekly arrangement normal plus overtime at most 12 a day.

ROSTER_SHIFT_CHANGE_REST.description: Checks that a shift worker has at least 12 hours between the end of the previous shift and the start of the next.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.110: a shift worker rests at least 12 hours before moving to another shift.

ROSTER_MINOR_WORKING_TIME.description: Checks that a roster day with planned overtime is allowed for the employee's age and listed-job status.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.146: under 15 at most 4 hours a day and 20 a week, no overtime or night work; from 15 to under 18 at most 8 a day and 40 a week, overtime and night work only in the jobs the Minister lists (term fact minor_listed_job); night is 22:00–06:00 (art.106).

ROSTER_MATERNITY_NIGHT_OVERTIME.description: Checks planned overtime: a pregnant employee has none (no consent exception); one raising a child under 12 months needs the day’s overtime consent.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.137(1): no overtime from the seventh month of pregnancy (estimated delivery within three months on employee_contract.children), with no consent exception; while raising a child under 12 months, overtime needs the day's consent.

ROSTER_UNDER_13.description: Checks that work by a child under 13 is limited to approved arts, physical-training or sports work.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): the employer may not recruit or use a person under 13, except in arts, physical training or sports work that does not harm the child, with the provincial labour authority’s consent (term fact child_arts_sports_approved).

ENCASHMENT_PRIOR_WAGE_REVIEW.description: Checks that an exit leave encashment reviews the wage of the month before the exit month and records that month’s daily wage.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.113(3): an employee who leaves or loses the job without having taken, or without having taken all, annual leave is paid the wages for the untaken days.
Decree 145/2020/ND-CP art.67(3): the wage basis for the untaken days is the contractual wage of the month immediately preceding the month of termination or job loss.

occupational_accident_reduced.title: Approved reduced occupational accident rate
occupational_accident_reduced.description: Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1): the occupational accident and disease fund rate is 0.5% of the salary; the reduced 0.3% applies only to an employer the Ministry approved on application (art.4(1)(b), art.5). Unrecorded is the 0.5% rate.

six_monthly_health_checks.title: Six-monthly health checks
six_monthly_health_checks.description: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.21(1): health checks at least once a year, every six months for heavy, hazardous or dangerous work, minors, the disabled and the elderly. Set when the entity employs any of them; unrecorded raises the yearly check only.

work_expense_limit.title: Monthly work-expense allowance limit (internal rules)
work_expense_limit.description: PIT: phone, stationery, travel and work-clothing allowances are taxable only above this level (Decree 253/2026 art.8(2)(đ)). Unrecorded is 0: the whole allowance is taxable.

foreign_worker_database_available.description: Whether the employer foreign-worker information for the reporting period can actually be obtained from the official foreign-worker database. Only actual availability exempts the Decree393art37(6)(dd) periodic report; missing/false keeps the report reminder.

pdpl_exempt.title: Exempt from PDPL dossier and personnel duties
pdpl_exempt.description: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 art.38(2)–(3): a household business or micro-enterprise is exempt, and a small enterprise or startup may opt out for 5 years from 1 January 2026, from the impact assessment (arts.21–22) and the data-protection personnel (art.33(2)) duties — unless it processes sensitive data or the data of a large number of subjects, or provides data-processing services. Unrecorded is not exempt.

union_fee_quarterly.title: Union fee paid every three months
union_fee_quarterly.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.4(1)(b), (2)(b): an agricultural, forestry, fishery or salt employer paying wages by production cycle may register with the union to pay every three months, by the last day of the month after the cycle. Unrecorded is monthly.

union_fee_reduction_percent.title: Union fee reduction by decision (%)
union_fee_reduction_percent.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.12: after an art.13 suspension ends, an enterprise or cooperative that must still cut its workforce by the art.12(1) threshold may be granted a reduction of at most 20% of the 2% fee (art.12(3)), by month and for at most 6 months (art.12(2)(a)), by decision of the Confederation or the provincial federation. Record the decided percentage only for those months; unrecorded is 0. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

union_fee_suspended.title: Union fee suspended by decision
union_fee_suspended.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.13: the Vietnam General Confederation of Labour or the provincial federation may suspend the 2% union fee, by month and for at most 12 months, for an enterprise or cooperative in difficulty from restructuring, technological change, economic crisis, State restructuring policy, natural disaster, fire, epidemic or crop failure that meets art.13(2). Record it only for the decision’s months; unrecorded is the fee in full. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

region.title: Worksite minimum-wage region
region.description: The regional minimum wage that applies to the worksite (Decree 399/2026/NĐ-CP art.3 and Annex). Drives the wage floors, the unemployment-insurance cap and the union dues cap.

first_employed_on.title: First employed on
first_employed_on.description: The day the employer first employed anyone, used for the foreign-worker ratio.

operations_started_on.title: Operations started on
operations_started_on.description: The day the employer began operations.

pit_quarterly_filer.title: Quarterly PIT filer
pit_quarterly_filer.description: Before 15 April 2026 only: the entity files PIT withholding declarations quarterly instead of monthly. From then on Resolution 66.16/2026/NQ-CP makes every salary return quarterly and this is not read.

employee_extension_schema.title: VN employee inputs

as_of.description: Exact accrual/request/exit date reviewed. The seed does not treat an earlier date in the month as an exact later-date calculation.

reference.description: Service calculation including sickness up to two months, agreed unpaid leave up to one month, maternity, occupational accident and other art.65 service.

carry_previous_year_days.description: Untaken eligible leave from the immediately preceding year at the start of this year; exact reviewed opening balance, not remaining balance after current-year use. Required, including explicit zero, when annual_leave_combined is true.

carry_second_previous_year_days.description: Untaken eligible leave from two years before at the start of this year; allowed only under the three-year combining agreement. Required, including explicit zero, when annual_leave_combined is true.

domestic_worker.title: Domestic worker
domestic_worker.description: Paid work in a household (Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.161). Outside compulsory SI, HI and UI; the employer pays the insurance-equivalent allowance instead (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

probation_class.title: Probation job class (Labour Code art.25)
probation_class.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: probation at most 180 days for an enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises, Law on State Capital), 60 days for a job needing college-level or higher qualifications, 30 days for intermediate-level, technical-worker or clerical jobs, 6 working days for any other job. Record it on probation terms.

pass_type.title: Work-permit basis
pass_type.description: INTRA_COMPANY_TRANSFER is outside compulsory SI (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

minor_listed_job.title: A job listed for minors’ overtime and night work

child_arts_sports_approved.title: Under-13 arts or sports work approved
child_arts_sports_approved.description: Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): a child under 13 works only in arts, physical training or sports work with the provincial labour authority’s consent; true records that consent.

special_role_notice.title: Special-role notice period
special_role_notice.description: Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.7 (Labour Code arts.35(1)(d), 36(2)(d)): an aircrew member, aircraft or aviation equipment maintenance staff, flight dispatcher, enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises; Law on State capital), ship crew working abroad or a seafarer on a Vietnamese ship abroad. Notice is at least 120 days for an indefinite or 12-month-plus contract and a quarter of the term for a shorter one.

receiving_pension.description: A worker already receiving a retirement pension: outside compulsory social, health-by-employer and unemployment insurance (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2), so the SI-equivalent allowance is paid instead.

disabled.description: A person with a disability: fourteen days of annual leave (Labour Code 2019 art.113(1)) and the disabled new-hire unemployment-insurance relief.

salary_vnd.description: Legally established monthly insurance salary before ceilings; actual stoppage salary or part-time monthly earnings, not the unreduced ordinary contract salary (Law 41/2024 art.31).

si_temporarily_suspended.description: True only for the applicable compulsory-SI month of temporary detention/disciplinary suspension under Law 41/2024 art.37(2); ordinary unpaid leave follows its existing rule.

union_dues_exempt.description: Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ exempt month: SI benefits for at least one month or no-income unpaid personal leave for at least one month.

reference.description: Insurance agency/employment-wage calculation establishing the month, salary, any suspension and arrears. Partial/split-month stoppage is not approximated.
Previous-month contract/allowance evidence and the six-month contractual wage history; required because earned.previous_month has no historical allowance list.

daily_wage_vnd.description: Contractual daily wage for the month before the exit month (Decree 145/2020 art.67(3)). The exit encashment conversion reads it; zero is refused.

average_contract_wage_vnd.description: Average contractual monthly wage of the six months before the contract ends (Decree 145/2020 art.8(5)); the severance and job-loss allowances read it, and zero is refused.

work_authorisation_application_submitted.description: Actual submission date of the pending issue/extension/reissue application. Art35(2) preserves Decree219 treatment only where submitted before2026-12-05; missing is not treated as an old filed application.

work_authorisation_extension_count.description: Number of extensions actually recorded on the current authorisation. Zero selects extension90-day opening; one or more requires a fresh issue application60-day opening (arts9(8),21(3),30). No missing-value zero assumption.

work_location_change_on.description: Actual expected first day at a new or changed stable/regular work location. Permit/certificate holders must notify both authorities at least3 working days earlier (arts10(5),23(5)).

work_authorisation_invalidated_on.description: Actual date the recorded art31(1)/art33(1)-(3) invalidation ground occurred. Natural permit expiry alone is not a mandatory-return ground under art31(1).

work_authorisation_invalidation_ground.description: Documented invalidation ground. PERMIT uses LabourCode156(2)-(7)/Decree393art31(1); certificate uses only Decree393art33(1)-(3). Other authority-decision cases must follow the actual decision; no invented10-day clock.

pension_eligible.title: Qualifies for a pension on leaving
pension_eligible.description: Labour Code 2019 art.46(1): no severance allowance where the employee qualifies for a pension under the social insurance law (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.64).

absent_five_days.title: Dismissed for five days' unexcused absence
absent_five_days.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(e): the employer ended the contract after five consecutive working days absent without good reason; art.46(1) owes no severance allowance.

final_settlement_extended.title: Settlement period extended to 30 days
final_settlement_extended.description: Labour Code 2019 art.48(1): settlement within 14 working days of termination; only art.48(1)(a)–(d) — the employer ceased operating; restructuring, technological change or economic reasons; a merger, division, sale or transfer; natural disaster, fire, enemy action or epidemic — allow up to 30 days. Unrecorded is the 14-day rule.

unlawful_resignation.title: Left unlawfully
unlawful_resignation.description: Labour Code art.40: a worker who ended the contract unlawfully gets no severance and owes half a month’s wage and the unserved notice.

long_illness.title: Ended for a long illness
long_illness.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(b): the employer ended the contract because the employee stayed unable to work after the treatment period (12 months indefinite, 6 months fixed term, half the term under 12 months); art.36(2)(c) needs only 3 working days’ notice, whatever the contract term.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

registration_number.title: SI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

si_treaty_exempt.title: Exempt from Vietnamese SI by treaty
si_treaty_exempt.description: SI standing: a foreign employee an international agreement Vietnam is party to exempts (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

registration_number.title: HI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

hi_treaty_exempt.description: HI standing only: an applicable international agreement specifically exempts Vietnamese HI under Health Insurance Law art.12(1)(c). SI pension-treaty exemption alone does not establish HI exemption.

registration_number.title: UI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

pension_qualified.title: Already qualifies for a pension
pension_qualified.description: UI standing: an employee who qualifies for a pension is outside unemployment insurance (Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(2)).

disabled_new_hire_relief.title: Disabled new hire registered for the UI relief
disabled_new_hire_relief.description: UI standing: a disabled worker hired from 1 January 2026, registered with the SI agency with the disability certificate; the employer pays 0% UI for 12 months (Decree 374/2025/NĐ-CP art.5).

UNION_FEE.title: Trade Union Fee (Kinh phí công đoàn)

PIT.title: Personal Income Tax (Thuế thu nhập cá nhân)

registration_number.title: PIT registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

commitment_form.title: Commitment form 08/CK-TNCN filed
commitment_form.description: PIT standing: a resident on no contract or one under three months who expects no taxable income after the family deduction; the 10% withholding is suspended (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.50(2)).

dependants.title: Registered dependants
dependants.description: PIT standing: each dependant registered with the tax authority is a monthly family deduction of 6,200,000 (Resolution 110/2025).

finalisation_authorised.title: Authorises the employer PIT finalisation
finalisation_authorised.description: PIT standing: the December run finalises the year only for an employee who authorised it and qualifies: one source of salary income under a labour contract of three months or more, still working here when the year is finalised, any other income at most 15,000,000 a month on average with 10% withheld (Decree 253/2026 art.51(1)(b), (2); Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d) before). Not for someone claiming a tax reduction or art.49 deductions, who finalises personally (art.51(3)). Set it only when every payment of the tax year is on this payroll, because the finalisation reads the year's balance, and not in a foreign resident's first year here, whose personal deduction runs from the month of arrival (art.48(1)(c)).

voluntary_pension_contribution.title: Voluntary pension / life-insurance contribution (VND a month)
voluntary_pension_contribution.description: PIT standing: the employee’s own monthly contribution to supplementary pension, voluntary pension or life insurance, deducted up to 3,000,000 a month (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.46(2)(a)).

dependants_registered_from.title: Dependants registered from (one month each)
dependants_registered_from.description: PIT standing: for each registered dependant, the month (YYYY-MM) from which the family deduction applies (Decree 253/2026 art.48(2)(a)); the December finalisation counts each from that month. Leave empty to count the registered dependants for the whole year.

UNION_DUES.title: Đoàn phí công đoàn (union membership dues)

union_member.title: Trade union member
union_member.description: UNION_DUES standing: a member pays 0.5% of the insurance salary, at most 10% of the reference level (Law 50/2024 art.29(1)(a); Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ).

probation_job_wage_vnd.title: Probation job wage (VND)
probation_job_wage_vnd.description: The wage the same job pays at the end of probation, used for the 85% probation floor.

separate_probation_contract.title: Probation under a separate probation contract
separate_probation_contract.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.24(1): probation is agreed in the labour contract or in a separate probation contract. Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(1)(a) insures a labour contract of one month or more, its probation clause included; only a separate probation contract is outside compulsory SI, HI, UI and the union fee. Unrecorded is a probation clause in the labour contract: insured from the first day.

employee_extension_schema.description: Additional local compliance facts on the sealed contract. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

SALARY_ADVANCE.description: Salary advance recovered from later pay.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.113(1): 12 working days in normal conditions, 14 for a minor, a worker with a disability or arduous, toxic or dangerous work, 16 for especially arduous, toxic or dangerous work; art.114: one more day for every full five years with the employer; art.113(2): under twelve months, the share of the months worked; art.113(3): untaken days are paid on leaving or losing the job; art.113(4): combined over at most three years only by agreement.

Decree 145/2020/ND-CP art.66(1): with fewer than twelve months worked in the year, the annual days plus seniority days (if any) / 12 x the months actually worked in the year; art.66(2): a part month counts when its working and paid leave days reach 50% of its normal working days as agreed; art.65: periods counted as work (sickness up to two months a year, agreed unpaid leave up to one month, maternity, occupational accident up to six months); a month art.65 does not count is HR's manual adjustment, reviewed at exit (annual_leave_service_review); art.67(3): untaken days are paid at the contract wage of the month before the exit month.

ANNUAL_LEAVE.description: Paid annual leave accrued by service.

references.title: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.43 — 30 working days a year under 15 years of contribution, 40 from 15 to under 30 years and 60 from 30 years, raised to 40, 50 and 70 for arduous, toxic or dangerous work; art.42 pays the days from the social insurance fund at 75% of the contribution salary of the preceding month, and art.47 requires the certificate of leave for social insurance benefit from the first day. the bands count years of social-insurance contribution (Law 41/2024 art.43; `SI.since_months`); the days are paid by the fund at 75% of the last contribution salary, not by the employer (`paid_by: FUND`). Law on Social Insurance 2024 art.43(1)(b): the longer bands are for work that is arduous, toxic or dangerous, or especially so (`classification in [ARDUOUS, ESPECIALLY_ARDUOUS]`).

Labour Code 2019 art.139(1) with Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53 — six months before and after childbirth, one further month for each child from the second in a multiple birth, paid from the social insurance fund at 100% of the average contribution salary of the six months before the leave. six months per birth, one more for every further child of a multiple birth (art.139(1); one further month read for a twin or more), for a member of six months’ contributions in the twelve before the birth (Law 41/2024 art.50; `SI.since_months`); paid by the fund at the six-month average, not by the employer (`paid_by: FUND`). Labour Code 2019 art.139: every female employee has the six months’ leave; the allowance is the fund’s (`paid_by: FUND`) and needs six months of contributions in the twelve before the birth (Law on Social Insurance 2024 art.50) — a mother short of it is on leave without the allowance, not without the leave. the grant is calendar months, not days (`calendar_months`): Labour Code 2019 art.139(1) “06 tháng … thêm 01 tháng” for each child from the second of a multiple birth (triplets eight months, `children.born_on(event.date)`), counted from the event’s first leave day, rest days and holidays inside the period (Law 41/2024 art.53(9)); the law states no day arithmetic, so the period ends the day before the same day of the closing month, or on that month’s last day where it has none (recorded default). Engine (round 7): calendar days of six months from the first leave day, one month more per further child of the birth (entry facts event_id, children_born); an adoption runs to the child's six months (Law 41/2024 art.56); a man takes it for an adoption, after the mother's death or as the commissioning father (Law 41/2024 arts.53, 56–57; entry fact maternity_case).

Law 41/2024 art.53(2)-(3): five working days; seven for surgery or birth before 32 weeks; twins ten plus three per further child, or fourteen plus three per further child for surgery. The start of the final leave segment must be within 60 days after birth; full benefit-file review remains required.

Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53(2) — five working days for an insured father, seven where the birth is by caesarean section or before 32 weeks, ten for twins with three more for each further child, and fourteen for twins delivered by caesarean section; the leave must fall within 60 days of the birth. five working days per birth, seven for a caesarean or a birth before 32 weeks, ten for twins and fourteen for twins by caesarean (Law 41/2024 art.53(2); `event.kind`); paid by the fund (`paid_by: FUND`).

Law 41/2024 art.53(3), effective 1 July 2025. Every paternity segment must START within the first 60 calendar days, counting the birth/event day as day 1; it may finish later. Exact official BHXH HCMC example published 10 February 2026: birth 10 September 2025 permits starts through 8 November inclusive; 9 November is too late. Eligibility requires the documented benefit_event_on and unique event_id, and checks every entry.from against event+59, not its end date. For qualifying pregnancy loss under art.52(2), record the documented loss event date.
Labour Code 2019 art.115(1)(a) — three days of paid leave on the employee's own marriage. a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.115(1)(a): 03 days on the employee’s own marriage.
Labour Code 2019 art.115(1)(b) — one day of paid leave on the marriage of the employee's natural or adopted child. a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.115(1)(b): 01 day on the marriage of a natural or adopted child.

CHILD_MARRIAGE_LEAVE.description: One paid day when the employee’s child marries (Labour Code art.115(1)(b)); paid in full.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.115(1)(c) — three days of paid leave on the death of a natural or adoptive parent, a parent-in-law, a spouse or a child. a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.115(1)(c): 03 days on the death of a parent, a parent of the spouse, the spouse or a child.

Labour Code 2019 art.115(2) — one day of unpaid leave, on notice to the employer, on the death of a grandparent or a sibling, on a parent's marriage or on a sibling's marriage. a grant per event, not per year (art.115: `event.kind`, `event.relationship`).

BEREAVEMENT_LEAVE_UNPAID.description: One unpaid day for the death of a grandparent or sibling, or the marriage of a parent or sibling (Labour Code art.115(2)); the day is not paid.

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.115(3) (Official Gazette 993+994 p.50, https://congbaocdn.chinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2019/11/30232/29070-1-2019993-99445-2019-qh14.pdf): beyond the art.115(1)–(2) days, the worker may agree with the employer to take unpaid leave; the law sets no length. The days are unpaid (deducted at the working-day rate, work_rules.proration) and each wholly unpaid working day counts toward the 14-day SI/HI/UI month (Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.33(5), 34(3); Law 74/2025/QH15 art.33(4)). Added 2026-09-30: a missing row of unchanged law, fixed in place in every version.

Labour Code 2019 art.112(1) — eleven days of paid public holiday a year: New Year's Day, five days of Lunar New Year, Hung Kings Commemoration Day, Reunification Day, International Labour Day and two days of National Day.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.112(1): 11 days of paid public holiday a year.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14
references.quote: Art.111(3): a weekly rest day that falls on an art.112(1) public holiday is rested on the next working day; art.112(1): the holiday is off on full pay. No yearly days in lieu.

PUBLIC_HOLIDAY_IN_LIEU.description: A paid day off in place of a public holiday that fell on a weekly rest day.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.112(2) — "Lao động là người nước ngoài làm việc tại Việt Nam ngoài các ngày nghỉ theo quy định tại khoản 1 Điều này còn được nghỉ thêm 01 ngày Tết cổ truyền dân tộc và 01 ngày Quốc khánh của nước họ." Two further paid days on top of art.112(1), for a foreign employee only. Seeded as an entitlement of two paid days, which is the whole of it: an event-driven head states a count and the employee takes it when the event falls, exactly as MARRIAGE_LEAVE states three days without a marriage calendar. Nothing here waits on the employee's own country's dates.
Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.112(2): one day of the traditional new year and one national day of the foreign worker’s country.

FOREIGN_NATIONAL_LEAVE.description: Two paid days a year for a foreign employee: one traditional new year and one national day of their country (Labour Code art.112(2)); paid in full.

references.title: Labour Code 2019 art.99(2): the worker at fault is not paid. an unpaid day (`paid_share = 0`). Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.99 (Official Gazette 993+994, 26 December 2019); Decree 145/2020/ND-CP arts.8(3)(a), 65(9) (Official Gazette 1203+1204, 28 December 2020): only stoppage not caused by the worker is counted service for severance and annual leave.

STOPPAGE_WORKER_FAULT.description: Work stopped through the employee’s own fault (Labour Code art.99(2)); the day is not paid.

references.title: Law 41/2024/QH15 art.44: caring for a sick child, at most 20 days a year for a child under 3 and 15 days for a child from 3 to under 7, per child; paid by the SI fund. Entry facts child_id, child_birthdate.

CHILD_SICK_CARE.description: Days caring for a sick child under 7; the social-insurance fund pays the benefit (Law 41/2024/QH15), so the payroll does not pay the day.

PRENATAL_CHECKUP.description: Days for prenatal check-ups; the social-insurance fund pays the benefit (Law 41/2024/QH15), so the payroll does not pay the day.

references.title: Law 41/2024 art.52(2): loss at or beyond 22 weeks with art.50 qualification takes childbirth maternity/paternity leave. Use MATERNITY_LEAVE with maternity_case PREGNANCY_LOSS_AT_22_WEEKS and documented childbirth_benefit_qualified; this ordinary maximum applies only when qualification is explicitly false.
Law 41/2024 arts.52(3), 57(2), 46(1), 60(1): these continuous benefit-leave durations include weekly rest and public holidays; use calendar days, not working days.
Law 41/2024/QH15 art.52: 10 days under 5 weeks' gestation, 20 from 5 to under 13, 40 from 13 to under 22, 50 from 22 weeks, rest days included (entry fact gestation_weeks); SI fund.

MISCARRIAGE_LEAVE.description: Leave after a miscarriage, abortion or stillbirth; the social-insurance fund pays the benefit (Law 41/2024/QH15), so the payroll does not pay the day.

references.title: Law 41/2024 art.57: medically prescribed intrauterine device leave up to seven calendar days and sterilisation up to fifteen calendar days, including rest days and public holidays.

CONTRACEPTION_LEAVE.description: Leave for contraceptive measures; the social-insurance fund pays the benefit (Law 41/2024/QH15), so the payroll does not pay the day.

references.title: Law 41/2024 arts.46 and 60: medically justified recovery within the statutory period, at most ten, seven or five continuous calendar days according to the relevant illness/birth/surgery case; SI fund. Rest days and public holidays count. The original references to article 61 were incorrect.

CONVALESCENCE_LEAVE.description: Recovery days after sickness, maternity or an occupational accident; the social-insurance fund pays the benefit (Law 41/2024/QH15), so the payroll does not pay the day.

references.title: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.38(3): the employer pays the full contract wage during treatment.

OCCUPATIONAL_ACCIDENT_LEAVE.description: Treatment days after an occupational accident or disease; the employer pays the full wage (OSH Law 84/2015/QH13 art.38(3)).

references.title: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.128(2): suspension of at most 15 days, 90 in special cases (entry fact special_case); during it the worker is advanced 50% of the wage before the suspension; a worker then disciplined keeps the advance, one not disciplined is paid the full wage for the suspension (adhoc SUSPENSION_SETTLEMENT).

SUSPENSION_PENDING_DISCIPLINE.description: Suspension pending a disciplinary decision; half the day’s wage is advanced (Labour Code art.128(3)) and the rest is settled on SUSPENSION_SETTLEMENT if no discipline follows.

Law 41/2024 art.53(2)-(3): five working days; seven for surgery or birth before 32 weeks; twins ten plus three per further child, or fourteen plus three per further child for surgery. The start of the final leave segment must be within 60 days after birth; full benefit-file review remains required.

Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53(2) — five working days for an insured father, seven where the birth is by caesarean section or before 32 weeks, ten for twins with three more for each further child, and fourteen for twins delivered by caesarean section; the leave must fall within 60 days of the birth. five working days per birth, seven for a caesarean or a birth before 32 weeks, ten for twins and fourteen for twins by caesarean (Law 41/2024 art.53(2); `event.kind`); paid by the fund (`paid_by: FUND`). From 1 July 2026, Decree 168/2026/NĐ-CP art.2(1)(b) grants ten working days for a second child where the wife had exactly one prior living biological child; the wife’s event-specific count is required for single births, while multiple-birth grants remain higher. Official Gazette.

Law 41/2024 art.53(3), effective 1 July 2025. Every paternity segment must START within the first 60 calendar days, counting the birth/event day as day 1; it may finish later. Exact official BHXH HCMC example published 10 February 2026: birth 10 September 2025 permits starts through 8 November inclusive; 9 November is too late. Eligibility requires the documented benefit_event_on and unique event_id, and checks every entry.from against event+59, not its end date. For qualifying pregnancy loss under art.52(2), record the documented loss event date.

Labour Code 2019 art.139(1) with Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.53 — six months before and after childbirth, one further month for each child from the second in a multiple birth, paid from the social insurance fund at 100% of the average contribution salary of the six months before the leave. six months per birth, one more for every further child of a multiple birth (art.139(1); one further month read for a twin or more), seven months from 1 July 2026 only where the mother had exactly one living biological child at this birth (Population Law 113/2025 art.14(1)(a), Decree 168/2026 art.2(1)(a); `children.natural_surviving_before(event.date) == 1`; complete dated child history is required), for a member of six months’ contributions in the twelve before the birth (Law 41/2024 art.50; `SI.since_months`); paid by the fund at the six-month average, not by the employer (`paid_by: FUND`). Labour Code 2019 art.139: every female employee has the six months’ leave; the allowance is the fund’s (`paid_by: FUND`) and needs six months of contributions in the twelve before the birth (Law on Social Insurance 2024 art.50) — a mother short of it is on leave without the allowance, not without the leave. the grant is calendar months, not days (`calendar_months`): Labour Code 2019 art.139(1) “06 tháng … thêm 01 tháng” for each child from the second of a multiple birth (triplets eight months, `children.born_on(event.date)`), counted from the event’s first leave day, rest days and holidays inside the period (Law 41/2024 art.53(9)); the law states no day arithmetic, so the period ends the day before the same day of the closing month, or on that month’s last day where it has none (recorded default). Engine (round 7): calendar days of six months from the first leave day, one month more per further child of the birth, seven months for a second child (entry fact second_child: the mother had exactly one living biological child) (entry facts event_id, children_born); an adoption runs to the child's six months (Law 41/2024 art.56); a man takes it for an adoption, after the mother's death or as the commissioning father (Law 41/2024 arts.53, 56–57; entry fact maternity_case). A second-child birth of twins or more adds the multiple-birth month on top of the seven: Labour Code art.139(1) as amended by Population Law 113/2025/QH15 art.29(1) (“sinh đôi trở lên thì tính từ con thứ hai trở đi, cứ mỗi con, người mẹ được nghỉ thêm 01 tháng”), eight months for second-child twins (Ministry of Home Affairs answer, https://lsvn.vn/bo-noi-vu-giai-dap-ve-truong-hop-duoc-nghi-thai-san-8-thang-a178778.html).

Labour Code 2019 art.112(1) — eleven days of paid public holiday a year: New Year's Day, five days of Lunar New Year, Hung Kings Commemoration Day, Reunification Day, International Labour Day and two days of National Day. Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(2)(h): rent, electricity, water and related services the employer pays on the worker’s behalf are taxable at the amount paid but not above 15% of the worker’s total taxable income at the unit, the rent excluded. The employer pays the landlord, so the line is an employer cost, not pay. Counts toward PIT.HOUSING, where the PIT base takes the lower of the amount and that 15%. Rent paid to the landlord is not a wage paid to the worker, so it is outside the insurance salary of Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) and Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1); Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2). Prorated on the base salary’s basis (Decree 145/2020 art.54(1)(a)): the working days of the employment over the planned working days, a part of a semi-monthly half at the monthly day wage.

Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(2)(g) with art.69(1)(b): a meal allowance the employer pays is taxable only above 1,200,000 a month from 1 July 2026. Counts toward PIT.MEAL, where the PIT base takes only the part above the cap.
